speaker: Doctor
text: Greeting, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; can you describe exactly how your leg is positioned and when this started?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation with Right Femoral Nerve Compression (caused by posterior pelvic compression from the rear-end collision, indicated by immediate groin pain and leg positioning issues).
